title: Cross-Session Messaging
description: Claude Code sessions can now message each other on macOS and Linux, enabling sessions to share findings and decisions directly instead of requiring users to re-explain context across sessions. Released in version 2.1.224.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor introduced plugins giving coding agents direct access to Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar. Users can now read, write, and act across their Google Workspace without leaving Cursor.
